Entity.name: Qualifying central counterparty (QCCP)
Entity.commentInRDBMS: A qualifying central counterparty (QCCP) is an entity that is licensed to operate as a CCP by the relevant regulator and that is based and prudentially supervised in a jurisdiction where the relevant regulator has implemented domestic rules for financial market infrastructures that are consistent with the PFMIs by CPMI-IOSCO. (Basel Committee on Banking Supervision Capital requirements for bank exposures to central counterparties)
